ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels to 35% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral lobe surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity white zone occupies the central and proximal areas of the lobe. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous boundary along the trailing edge and distal tip, with high-frequency mottling/speckling at the transition zone between the white and black regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge exhibits a series of irregular, jagged serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 10 and 30 pixels. Frequency of peaks increases toward the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a convex mathematical curve that tapers into a distinct, slightly upturned distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A dense cluster of circular, high-contrast tan and white pixel groups is localized at the extreme distal tip, indicating localized surface texture variation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, unaligned white linear pixel paths are visible crossing the black-pigmented region near the trailing edge, specifically one prominent diagonal mark near the mid-lobe and several smaller horizontal marks near the tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent white linear rake marks/scars cutting through the dark pigmentation on the upper-right quadrant of the visible fluke; significant cluster of raised/scarred tissue at the distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Faint yellowish-tan pixel staining is visible in the lower-central region of the white field.
